verses.1: And you said on that day, “May the LORD be with you, for you have sat in my place and comforted me.”
verses.2: See, my Savior is with me; I will not fear anymore. For the Lord has spoken through His prophets. May there be salvation for me.
verses.3: And you took water from the springs of salvation.
verses.4: And on that day, you shall say: “Praise the LORD!” Call upon His name. Let people know about His greatness. Remember that His name is honored among all nations.
verses.5: Sing to the LORD, for he has made known this truth throughout all the earth.
verses.6: Tzahalivorni sits in Zion, as if she were a great queen among you. Holy Israel!
